C0.quote: we study the complexity of deciding whether voters’ preferences can be explained
C0.note: The main object is the recognition of structured preference domains (partitioning a preference profile into k single-peaked/group-separable/value-restricted subprofiles), not a procedure aggregating inputs into a collective decision or strategic/computational aspects of such a procedure; no voting rule is studied (voting rules such as Chamberlin-Courant are mentioned only as motivation in the Introduction). Coding stopped per codebook.
